## Hello

I'm a biostatistician working at the intersection of **clinical development,
regulatory science, and real-world evidence**.

I'm currently Senior Manager, Biostatistics at **Pfizer** in Chennai — an
Associate Director–equivalent role on the Data Science & Analytics India
leadership team — leading a team of statisticians across global Oncology and
Inflammation & Immunology programs.

Before Pfizer I was a primary statistical reviewer at the **FDA's Oncology
Center of Excellence**, where I reviewed NDA, BLA, and IND submissions across
several solid-tumor indications, led sponsor–agency labelling negotiations, and
worked on one of the agency's early evaluations of external-control cohorts in a
pediatric neuroblastoma program. Earlier I was a tenure-track Assistant Professor
of Statistics at the University of Northern Colorado.

What connects all of it: taking complex quantitative science and turning it into
decisions people can actually act on.

## Currently

- **Role** — Senior Manager, Biostatistics, Pfizer Healthcare India · Chennai
- **Leading** — statistical strategy across global Oncology and I&I development programs
- **Building** — enterprise capability in real-world evidence and target trial emulation
- **Interests** — estimand and endpoint strategy, Bayesian and adaptive designs,
